meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发布前自动审查代码变更，确保质量达标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在npm发布前需要多维度自动化代码审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review code changes before release to ensure quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent automated code review before npm publish

howto.what: 当你要求预发布审查时,Claude 会先找出上次 npm 发布以来的全部代码改动,再派出最多 16 个后台智能体分三层审查(逐项深入分析、整体复查、最终发布评估),最后给出各层结论、版本升级建议、破坏性变更和风险等级。
howto.when: 只有你明确要求“发布前审查”时才触发,例如说“pre-publish review”“release review”“can I publish?”等;普通发布/发布请求不会触发,仍按原流程直接发布。

say.text: 帮我做一次发布前审查,检查上次发布以来的所有改动。
say.note: 会先检测未发布变更,再分派审查智能体。

say.text: 发布之前先跑完整预发布审查,告诉我能不能发。
say.note: 返回各层结论与整体风险。

say.text: 我要发 npm 包,先做预发布检查。
say.note: 普通发布不会触发,必须明确说预发布检查。

howto.what_en: After installation, requesting a pre-publish review makes Claude detect all changes since the last npm release, spawn up to 16 background agents across three layers (per-change, holistic, release synthesis), and report verdicts, version bumps, breaking changes and risk.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review (e.g., 'pre-publish review', 'release review', 'can I publish?'). A plain publish/release request does NOT trigger it.

say_en.text: Run a pre-publish review covering all changes since the last release.
say_en.note: Starts change detection, then the three review layers.

say_en.text: Before publishing, run the full pre-publish review and tell me if I can ship.
say_en.note: You'll get per-layer verdicts and overall risk.

say_en.text: Do a pre-release check before I publish to npm.
say_en.note: A plain publish request won't trigger this.
